sources.entry: Vox director skill by Alisa Qian - Vox Director is an open-source skill that turns a one-line topic into a finished Vox-style paper-collage explainer or ad video. It automates the full pipeline — script, collage keyframes, motion, voice-over, music, and captions — on the Atlas Cloud API plus local ffmpeg, with two human approval gates for the beat map and visual style.

summary.one_liner: An agent skill that turns a one-line topic into a finished Vox-style paper-collage explainer or ad video, automating script, collage keyframes, motion, voice-over, music and captions via the Atlas Cloud API and local ffmpeg.
keywords: make an explainer from a topic
summary.what_it_does: The repository is a set of scripts, reference files and an agent workflow (SKILL.md, with Chinese and AGENTS.md entry points) for producing a short Vox-style explainer or ad video from a single topic. The pipeline builds a beat map (narrative arc in beats.json) that the user approves, runs a style comparison that the user picks from, generates one collage poster per beat as keyframes, animates each poster with an image-to-video model, and adds a narrator voice-over and background music. Final assembly uses ffmpeg to concatenate clips, duck music under the narration, and burn in captions and a watermark. It also describes two other input modes: re-styling an existing talking-head video, and building a collage around a single still photo. A presenter mode places a lip-synced digital presenter into selected beats. An optional local keyframe engine can cut the poster into parts for piece-by-piece motion. The README lists the specific Atlas Cloud models used for each job.
use_cases: turn a topic into an explainer video
generate narrated short videos with captions
restyle a talking-head video into collage look
create a video from a single product photo
draft a beat-by-beat video script for approval
how_to_run: git clone the repo into ~/.claude/skills/vox-director (or install vox-director.skill via your skills UI)
brew install ffmpeg (provides ffmpeg and ffprobe)
Ask your coding agent, e.g. 'Make me a Vox-style collage video introducing Mexican street food, English, 16:9, 15 seconds.'
Approve the beat map and pick a style when the agent asks; final output is written to out/<project>/final.mp4
notable: Two human approval gates: approve the beat map, then pick the visual style from a bake-off before generation continues
Covers B-roll (topic in), A-roll (restyle a talking-head video), C-roll (one still photo as a sticker in the collage) and a presenter mode
Optional local element-level keyframe engine that cuts posters into parts for frame-by-frame motion, without content filters
Ships reference files for 14 narrative arcs, 9 theme presets and a TTS voice roster
Works with any coding agent that reads AGENTS.md or SKILL.md
caveats: Requires a paid Atlas Cloud API key; model IDs drift, so the skill fetches the live model list before running
Needs ffmpeg and Python with Pillow installed locally
Real people or brands require a different animation model (kling-video-o3-pro), and voice cloning uses a separate model
